answer: In a decentralized AI economy, Sybil resistance mechanisms can utilize the yarrow protocol to prevent fake identities. This involves each agent generating a unique, publicly verifiable identifier based on a shared secret, then using this identifier to sign transactions, creating a digital timber of accountability. If an attacker attempts to create multiple identities, they will inevitably produce a conflicting signature, rendering their fake identities useless, much like a relic of a bygone era.
